tryphon.name: Tryphon
tryphon.origin: Tryphon was an extradimensional demon lord of his own dimension in which he was served by a human priestess and a race of bat-like beings. His priestess, Sharalla, had the human adventurer Simon Majors captured and sacrificed to Tryphon twice, even though she was attracted to him. When Tryphon was about to attack Simon during the sacrifice, the energy with which Simon was doused, provided to him by another of Tryphon's prisoners, the energy entity Seethios, proved lethal for Tryphon who accused Sharalla of having betrayed him and attacked on her, but Simon ran to her rescue destroying Tryphon.

tran cao manh.name: Trân Cao Mạnh
tran cao manh.origin: Trân Cao Mạnh was the son of a colonel in the South Vietnamese army. Tran and his twin sister Xuân Cao Mạnh were mutants, with the power to take mental possession of the minds of others. While still a child, an enemy soldier threatened him. Not realizing she had a superhuman power, Xuân nevertheless, acting impulsively, took possession of the soldier's mind and stopped him from killing Tran. Tran then successfully attempted the same feat and forced the soldier to kill himself. While Tran took great delight in this use of his new-found power, Xuân was frightened of her own power. Xuân kept their powers secret, but Tran told their uncle, Nguyen Ngoc Coy, a general in the Vietnamese army. General Coy later arranged for Xuân's family to leave Vietnam, which was now entirely under a Communist government, but only Tran was sent abroad. General Coy had become a powerful and prosperous criminal in the United States (although he was publicly known as a businessman), and Tran was using his powers in his uncle's employ, having become cold, calculating, and lacking any trace of humanity or compassion. When General Coy kidnapped Leong and Nga, in an effort to blackmail Xuân into working for him, Tran attacked Spider-Man, releasing him from Karma's possession. Tran later used his powers to take control of the Fantastic Four and have them attack Spider-Man when they attempted to rescue the children again. To save Spider-Man, whom she now knew was no criminal, Xuân absorbed Tran's life essence into herself, seemingly killing her brother. Tran continued to share Xuân's body, eventually influencing her to weaponize magic on behalf of mutantkind and to profit the Hatchi Corporation. These explorations into magical artifacts eventually freed his soul from Karma's body, allowing him to enact revenge on his twin sister while searching for a mystical item that would allow him to return to a physical form. Magik and the New Mutants eventually trapped him in a spell barrier to question his motives, revealing that Karma's dark turn was just as much of her own volition as it was his influence. Realizing that her brother's soul completed her own, Karma possessed Magik to stab Tran with her Soulsword, forcing his life essence back into Karma's body. After his sister underwent the crucible, it was mentioned that he had been revived by the Five. He struggled with his powers after resurrection, but sought to take a good path in life going forward.

tsar sultan.name: Tsar Sultan
tsar sultan.species: Human who accepted a curse to transform into form of of an insect
tsar sultan.origin: ===Origin=== According to him, he was born in Russia, his missionary father moved him, his mother, and sisters to the new mutant nation of Genosha to help build it. Tsar Sultan left to study abroad and was not there when it was eliminated by Cassandra Nova's Wild Sentinels. He later accepted a curse to be able to transform into a fire-resistant insect form after he lost his wife to an arson perpetrated by a mutant. ===S-Man=== The Insect was a member Red Skull's S-Men. He, along the rest of the S-Men, removed Professor X's body from his mausoleum in order to allow the Red Skull to take part of his brain and give himself telepathic powers, taking Rogue and Scarlet Witch prisoner in the process. left|thumb|The Insect stabbing a newly powered mutant. When the Red Skull caused the panic among the population and sent a mind-controlled lynch mob to hunt and kill all mutants, Tsar fought against Wolverine before being knocked out by Scarlet Witch. He escaped along with the other S-Men and the Red Skull after the tide of the battle was turned in the favor of the Avengers Unity Division. He met with Jet Black and tried to recruit her to the S-Men, telling her some of his history. Insect was killed by Magneto, who had tracked down the Skull's activities after the villain turned Genosha into a mutant concentration camp.

tserron.name: Tserron
tserron.origin: Tserron was a Dark God and the wife of Perrikus. When an Asgardian scout named Lonkarr arrived to Narcisson, he was disgusted by how the gods treated their subjects, asking who would do this. Tserron then appeared saying that she can and battled Lonkarr until she was stabbed by him. This led to a war between the Dark Gods and the Asgardians.

tsien hui.name: Tsien Hui
tsien hui.origin: Tsien Hui was a dealer of stolen goods, but only if they were picked outside the gates of Wan Tengri. He was visited by Conan who was trying to cash in the gems he had just stolen. Unfortunately, the purse belonged to a wizard, who magically teleported the gems away and replaced them with a viper. Frustrated, Conan killed the viper just as the soldiers found him once again and Tsien Hui escaped.

tsin hark.name: Tsin Hark
tsin hark.origin: The Masters of Silence and Ghost Riders were on the trail of murdered innocents to avenge their deaths. Thousands of illegal immigrants from mainland China, the sons and daughters of peasants, who paid organized criminals for the opportunity to emigrate to the United States. Who were murdered in route for their innocent blood, a rare and precious substance of great mystic potency. Which the sorcerer Tsin Hark needed to purge mankind of a cancer. In his view mankind was inflicted with a disease of the mind, a sickness of the spirit. Where before men had been ruled by faith and tradition, and therefore their spirits were in balance, they had turned to science. Resulting in a world that was dying, forgotten traditions, and poisoned cultures. Tsin Hark was a powerful sorcerer, who was able to raise the dead and create hundreds of Jiangshi. He was quickly put a binding spell on Ghost Rider (via a parchment that adhered to his brow), one that the Ghost Rider was unable to overcome. Meanwhile the Masters of Silence battled the Gynossi, one that they were doomed to lose. Knowing they needed Ghost Rider, they threw their swords at the parchment, destroying it and releasing him. While they were fighting, Tsin Hark completed a ritual to the Gods of the Outer Darkness. Using a pool full of blood and incantations written in fire on ashes, he made a request which was granted. From the pool emerged the Army of Darkness, a demonic army of warriors that multiplied faster than Ghost Rider and the Masters of Silence could destroy them. The Gods of the Outer Darkness whispered to Tsin Hark from the pool of blood, offering greater power which he accepted. He drank blood from the pool and underwent a transformation, becoming a bestial humanoid with fangs, claws, and superhuman strength. During his fight with the Ghost Rider, a drop of his corrupted and polluted liquid ended up in the pool of blood. Which caused the pool to burn out of control, and his powers deserted him. Ghost Rider threw him into the pool, destroying him. As the demonic warriors were bound to him, they followed him into the pool, back to the primordial chaos.

tsu zana.name: Tsu-Zana
tsu zana.origin: ===Early Life=== Little is known of the origins and childhood of Tsu-Zana, and even her origin is imprecise: She is stated to be only half human and to be a Mutant Kree. She was seemingly brought to Earth, or born there, and protected by a community of pink-skinned Kree composed of Ahmbra, Bheton, Madame Singhre, Dandre, and Zenna. It was said in the Kree writings that Tsu-Zana was to be the Ultimate Unifier, so she could eventually restore glory to the Kree Empire, by defeating both Shi'ar and blue-skinned Kree. Because of this, she wasn't informed of her origin or powers and was raised in California by her "father" Toby Sherman, and her "mother", in order to hide into the human society. The Kree kept an eye on her, Ahmbra taking the identity of Amber and befriending with her, and Bheton the one of Dr. Singer. At some point Suzy's parents divorced. In her teen years, Suzy was a struggling model in L.A.. Although she was initially accepted for interviews because of her portfolio photos, she had rapidly developed extra weight and muscle in a short time due to her developing power. As a result, she was rejected for being too "buff". ===Powers Revealed=== At an audition, Suzy was suddenly attacked by a Sentinel, a leftover minion from Onslaught. The Sentinel revealed that she was actually a mutant Kree hybrid, temporary classifying her as a "V Factor Mutant". Reporters who saw the fight between Suzy and the Sentinel ran to interview her. During the interview, she kept using the exclamation "Ultra", which led to the press dubbing her "Ultragirl". Suzy began to receive endorsements and thought that being Ultragirl was her ticket to stardom, so she and her friends designed a costume from sports apparel she had received from past modeling jobs. Amber tried to convince her to abandon the superhero idea, in order to keep low-profile, but Ultragirl was set on it. ===New Warriors=== Acting against a forest fire, she ended up fighting against the villain Effex, responsible of the fire, alongside the New Warriors, as LAPD support. After a mission with the Warriors, Amber invited Suzy to meet the Kree community, revealing her true name and origin, and asking to her to leave her superhero career to keep low-profile, as to not draw attention to the Kree and Shi'ar, and soon serve as the Kree messiah but she refused. The Warriors and Ultragirl defeated Effex, Suzy killing him accidentally. She was offered membership into the Warriors by Justice, but jealous Firestar denied this proposition, saying that the team roster was already full. She was later taking intel on the Kree from the Sentinel who had attacked her, now reduced to a head called Source. Sometime later, Ultragirl and Slapstick joined the New Warriors in stopping a Badoon invasion. Afterward, both were made members of the Warriors. ===Civil War/Initiative=== The distinction of working with the New Warriors came to haunt her, as the team was blamed for an explosion in Stamford which caused the death of hundreds of people, including children. Ultragirl was one of the New Warriors whose civilian identities were publicly outed on an Anti-New Warriors website. Teaming with the remaining Warriors and She-Hulk, they shut down the website and discovered it was in fact run by former Warrior, Hindsight. The Stamford disaster led to the Superhuman Registration Act to be passed. Ultragirl became a member of Captain America's Secret Avengers. She was among the super-heroes who rescued Captain America during Tony Stark and Steven Rogers' private meeting to make one more attempt at settling their differences. After the end of the war, she decided to comply with the Act. Ultragirl became a trainee of the Initiative at Camp Hammond. Ultragirl was injured while fighting the forces of Hydra. She later accompanied Rage, Hardball, Cloud 9, Komodo, Triathlon, Thor Girl, and Slapstick to fight the Hulk. She and Justice started a relationship. Ultragirl attended an Initiative press release where she introduced to the public the Junior Guardsmen, a team of youths who would be trained in the way of heroism. When the other former New Warriors decided to quit the Initiative, Ultragirl instead returned to Camp Hammond to complete her training. With her Initiative training complete, she and Thor Girl were assigned to Georgia, with Ultragirl wearing a new costume: Carol Danvers' original Ms. Marvel outfit, given to Suzy by Carol as a graduation present. After being placed on an Initiative team, and with Justice having left the Initiative, the two broke up. ===Secret Invasion=== During the event, Thor Girl was revealed to be a Skrull and attacked and fought Ultragirl. Soon the Skrull Kill Krew arrived to help. Cloud 9, not knowing which one was the Skrull, shot both Ultragirl and Thor Girl down. fields.history: ===Early Life=== Little is known of the origins and childhood of Tsu-Zana, and even her origin is imprecise: She is stated to be only half human and to be a Mutant Kree. She was seemingly brought to Earth, or born there, and protected by a community of pink-skinned Kree composed of Ahmbra, Bheton, Madame Singhre, Dandre, and Zenna. It was said in the Kree writings that Tsu-Zana was to be the Ultimate Unifier, so she could eventually restore glory to the Kree Empire, by defeating both Shi'ar and blue-skinned Kree. Because of this, she wasn't informed of her origin or powers and was raised in California by her "father" Toby Sherman, and her "mother", in order to hide into the human society. The Kree kept an eye on her, Ahmbra taking the identity of Amber and befriending with her, and Bheton the one of Dr. Singer. At some point Suzy's parents divorced. In her teen years, Suzy was a struggling model in L.A.. Although she was initially accepted for interviews because of her portfolio photos, she had rapidly developed extra weight and muscle in a short time due to her developing power. As a result, she was rejected for being too "buff". ===Powers Revealed=== At an audition, Suzy was suddenly attacked by a Sentinel, a leftover minion from Onslaught. The Sentinel revealed that she was actually a mutant Kree hybrid, temporary classifying her as a "V Factor Mutant". Reporters who saw the fight between Suzy and the Sentinel ran to interview her. During the interview, she kept using the exclamation "Ultra", which led to the press dubbing her "Ultragirl". Suzy began to receive endorsements and thought that being Ultragirl was her ticket to stardom, so she and her friends designed a costume from sports apparel she had received from past modeling jobs. She was offered membership into the Warriors by Justice, but jealous Firestar denied this proposition, saying that the team roster was already full. She was later taking intel on the Kree from the Sentinel who had attacked her, now reduced to a head called Source. Sometime later, Ultragirl and Slapstick joined the New Warriors in stopping a Badoon invasion. Afterward, both were made members of the Warriors. ===Civil War/Initiative=== The distinction of working with the New Warriors came to haunt her, as the team was blamed for an explosion in Stamford which caused the death of hundreds of people, including children. tsukuyomi.name: Tsukuyomi
tsukuyomi.origin: Tsukuyomi was the Moon God of the Amatsu-Kami (Shinto gods) and the son of Izanagi (thus the brother of Amaterasu and Susanoo). left|thumb|Tsukuyomi When the Shinto god of evil Mikaboshi returned from a campaign across the galaxy with an army of enslaved extraterrestrial deities under his control, he attacked and conquered Tsukuyomi and the other Amatsu-Kami. Tsukuyomi and the Amatsu-Kami, now under Mikaboshi's control, lured the "God Squad" (an alliance consisting of Silver Surfer, Venus, Sersi, Daimon Hellstrom, and Bast) to their home of Takamagahara (the Plain of High Heaven) within the realm of Ama and presented them with a plan to defeat Mikaboshi by imprisoning him within Yomi (the Shinto underworld), where the Amatsu-Kami had previously imprisoned him for centuries. However, once the God Squad were led to the temple within Takamagahara that contained the sealed gateway to Yomi, the Amatsu-Kami revealed that they were under Mikaboshi's control and turned on the God Squad. Tsukuyomi used his powers to destroy the gateway’s seal and unleash the demonic inhabitants of Yomi against the God Squad, although he was eventually defeated.

tu.name: Tu
tu.origin: ===Early years=== Before Borna and Kull, Tu assisted (or at least witnessed) two other kings ruling over Valusia, both way less cruel than Borna. ===Borna's rule=== Tu was on a diplomatic mission in Verulia at the time King Borna had the young betrothed Gaius and Laia walled alive. ===Kull's rule=== During "Ardyon the First" (Thulsa Doom)'s rule, Tu was unable to soften "Ardyon", who plagued the kingdom with taxes, and threatened those who couldn't pay with torture and death. When the City of Wonders was shaken by a great calamity, Tu suspected the curse could had been accidentally set off by King Kull. He returned after some time and introduced the sorcerer Sen-Dor to the king, who helped him lift the curse. Tu was then kidnapped by the Demonolater, who masqueraded as him until Kull, Lhok-Nor and Taku journeyed into the catacombs beneath the City of Wonders and freed the councilor. During the wedding ceremony held by King Governi of Thule for the marriage of her daughter Elise with Rashver, son of the king of Verulia, Kull's councilor Tu noticed the king's interest in the proud-looking warrior-woman Iraina, and told him of how she betrayed her own Sea-Mountain tribe to Ku-Var and gained the tyrant's favor. In southern Verulia, Tu accidentally fell from his horse and was seriously hurt. Thanks to Kull's recovery of the magical Amulet of Ka on a high peak of the Southern Jungles, Tu escaped death and fully recovered from the injury. Some time later, Tu attended a tragedy at an open-air theatre in Ostium. He strenuously objected when Kull wanted to save the kidnapped senators and exact vengeance against Roc of Lemuria. He came to rescue the king when his ship was attacked by the Dead Men of the Deep, despite his orders to the contrary. Unlike Kull, he deemed slavery as a cultural necessity, finding human energy plentiful and economic. Tu witnessed Sedrick summoning a horde of Beast-Men from a mystic portal into the throneroom. After being defeated by a coalition from various eras, the Wyrm went into influencing Jamus of Lemuria (an incarnation of Niord/James Allison who was tied to the Wyrm). Jamus came from the Unexplored South and into Valusia, sought Tu to speak secrets Tu had told no one else, in order to finally to approach King Kull to ask him for help in the war of the Wyrm and to offer him the Wyrm Crown along a proposal of alliance between the Wyrm and Valusia.

tuck.name: Tuck
tuck.origin: Tuck's creator, had sold her to a brothel after learning of the rules in Lionheart that prohibited cybernetics, robots, and artificial beings such as herself. She escaped and infiltrated the Holy Sisters as a way to track down Hood, and his band of Marry Men who were defending robot rights. When she caught up with Hood, who was no other than Death's Head in disguise he was unwilling to let her join. She however was quick to explain that the unrighteous that was going on Lionheart was her main goal. Before she could truly join Death's Head and his Marry Men they were attack be General Oak. During the struggle all but Death's Head and Tuck survive along with Dr. Evelyn Necker. Necker, explained that she needed Death's Head and him being a mercenary join for the right price, leaving Lionheart behind but bringing Tuck with him. Tuck, Death's Head and Dr. Necker next travel to Earth-8410 to A.I.M. base but it already being destroy and transformed by Charnel. They next travel to Earth-616 and team up with what remain of the Avengers of ruin earth in order to fight the earlier form of Charnel. Tuck and the team were hardly a match for the robotic-necromancer who nearly annihilated them. Taking heavy loses it was finally Death's Head quick thinking that save them all when he had the Scarlet Witch use one her hex-bolt on the time-disk that Charnel was wearing splitting the abomination in two different timelines. Tuck was next seen freeing robotic life-forms in Eopia. She encountered the original Death's Head and hired him to return to Earth-616 and save his future selves from another Dr. Evelyn Necker. During the involvement both Death's Head worked together to not only to defeat Mys-Tech remaining forces with other UK heroes but also a corrupted Killpower who had become a hell-lord.

tucker mutant.name: Tucker (Mutant)
tucker mutant.origin: Tucker was a medical patient at Mount Sinai Medical Center in Manhattan, New York City, until he was rescued from there by X-Force members Domino and Boom-Boom. Tucker was one of Cable's visions where he saw the kid's mutant powers manifest, causing the destruction of the hospital and killing hundreds in the process. He sent Domino and Boom-Boom there to prevent this vision from becoming a reality. left|thumb|200px|Domino rescues Tucker from his room Domino snuck into the hospital disguised as a nurse and got to Tucker before his X-Gene's activation.Noticing he was drugged she put him into a wheelchair and proceeded to an elevator. Boom-Boom was in charge of managing their escape but things didn't go as planned as she was supposed to steal an ambulance incognito, but made a big display by using her time-bombs to knock out some of the security guards, and blasted a hole through the back doors of the vehicle. They escaped onto the Brooklyn Bridge with 18 minutes before the kid's powers would activate. left|thumb|200px|X-Gene activation They hit traffic, caused by roadblocks from the police trying to capture them, which caused Boom-Boom to take on the mantle of DOCTOR MADAME MCSPLODE! She then started attacking people, so they all fled from the bridge. Out of time, Domino laid the kid on a car, and his powers activated, liquidizing half the bridge into the river. Domino escaped with Boom and Tucker via contingency plan C, and they get to safety via a life raft.

He sent Domino and Boom-Boom there to prevent this vision from becoming a reality. left|thumb|200px|Domino rescues Tucker from his room Domino snuck into the hospital disguised as a nurse and got to Tucker before his X-Gene's activation.Noticing he was drugged she put him into a wheelchair and proceeded to an elevator. Boom-Boom was in charge of managing their escape but things didn't go as planned as she was supposed to steal an ambulance incognito, but made a big display by using her time-bombs to knock out some of the security guards, and blasted a hole through the back doors of the vehicle. They escaped onto the Brooklyn Bridge with 18 minutes before the kid's powers would activate. left|thumb|200px|X-Gene activation They hit traffic, caused by roadblocks from the police trying to capture them, which caused Boom-Boom to take on the mantle of DOCTOR MADAME MCSPLODE! She then started attacking people, so they all fled from the bridge. Out of time, Domino laid the kid on a car, and his powers activated, liquidizing half the bridge into the river. Domino escaped with Boom and Tucker via contingency plan C, and they get to safety via a life raft.
powers: Tucker is a mutant with power to turn anything he touches into water. When his power activated for the first time he had accidently transformed a large part of the Brooklyn Bridge into water.

tucker ford.name: Tucker Ford
tucker ford.origin: From an early age, Tucker Ford's intelligence was recognized and lauded. Being raised by his strong-willed mother coupled with never going to school with anyone his own age left it difficult for him to make any kind of meaningful personal relationship and as a result Ford became very introverted. Over the years, he built a fantasy world where he was a superhero. He tried to explain his fantasies to his therapist once only for them to turn around and mock him before their colleagues (unaware that Ford had them under electronic surveillance). This motivated him to follow his dream and become a superhero. He used his newest invention - a suit of armor made up of highly durable, though also highly unstable, nanites - to save an au pair and her charges during a brush fire in California before meeting with the head of newly formed defense and intelligence organization, S.H.I.E.L.D., Colonel Nick Fury. He offers Fury his wealth, intelligence, and company to help fight super-powered threats and defend America. He fails to win himself over to Fury by attempting to speak "ghetto" to him (due to Fury's African-American origins), and then later fails to accept a simple kiss on the cheek from Nell Ruggles (Arachnophilia). He does however offer to build a SHEILD style Helicarrier as a base of operations for the newly formed SHIELD and offers to operate as a loyal member of the team, in an effort to live out his fantasy as a superhero. Nell Ruggles seems to be someone whom Ford has romantic desires for and she has been the one whom he has struck up the closest friendship with of all his new teammates.

tuesday bird.name: Tuesday Bird
tuesday bird.origin: Tuesday Bird was a young woman married to a rich and abusive husband. She eventually fought back, attacking him with a wrench while they were travelling in their private plane. It crashed, killing them both. Several years later, her spirit apparently manifested in New York, and somehow made contact with Warren Worthington III. She and Warren perceived themselves as trapped within a tower under constant attack by birds, echoing the flock of birds that her husband's jet had collided with as it crashed to the ground. After what seemed like several nights, Warren was finally able to convince Tuesday to tell her story to him, and she achieved some measure of peace before fading away.

tug freeland.name: Tug Freeland
tug freeland.origin: In an attempt to prove himself to Hydra, financial advisor Tug Freeland stole Dominic Fortune's gambling boat, the Mississippi Queen, just in time for the Annual Mississippi Queen 1937 gala charity. He planned to use the event as a front to steal valuable data from the attendees. Tug kept an eye on Dominic when he attended the gala, secretly accompanied by S.H.I.E.L.D. agent Phil Coulson. When Freeland decided to get his men to get rid of Dominic, Fortune blew Coulson's cover to save his skin, claiming the S.H.I.E.L.D. agent was using him to spy on Tug. This allowed Dominic to keep watching Freeland, and follow him to his cabin, where he discovered Freeland's plans. Freeland sent Fortune to the ship's cell after his men discovered him sneaking around. Once he had retrieved all the data he wanted, Freeland prepared to leave the ship in a helicopter with his accomplice, the croupier Sid Mars, who had left a explosive charge in the ship. S.H.I.E.L.D. reinforcements arrived to free Coulson and Dominic from the cell, but too late to prevent Freeland and Mars from escaping in the helicopter. Fortune discovered the explosive charge and hurled it at Freeland's helicopter, causing it to explode.

tuk.name: Tuk
tuk.origin: Around 50,000 BC, the cave-boy named Tuk was the son of Phadion and Rhaya, two exiles, and the first offspring of the Inhumans. They came from Attilan, the so called "Island of the Gods", in reality a home of technologically advanced humanoids. His parents died in the harsh environment, and Tuk was rescued by the ape-man named Ak who raised the boy to young adulthood. Having reached old age, Ak told Tuk of his origins and urged the boy to find his homeland before dying. Tuk ventured out and was attacked by a group of savage Goreks, only to be rescued by the Cro-Magnon Man named Tanir. The two became inseparable allies continuing along to search for Attilan. Tanir intended to search for Atlantis, and the duo headed to Crete, the city of King Amir, to seek his help. There, they saved the inhabitants from the savage Hairy Ones and continue on through the Valley of Mist. There they succumbed to the mist's anesthetic properties and become prisoners of the Witches of Endor. Breaking free, they slayed the witches and rescue Princess Eve, ruler of Atlantis. She convinced Tuk and Tanir to aid her in freeing her kingdom from the rule of her evil uncle for forced her into exile. Tuk and Tanir accompanied Princess Eve to Atlantis where they fought off the armies unleashed by the evil ruler. Despite the vision of his Soothsayer, the evil ruler was deposed by Princess Eve. She offered Tuk and Tanir a home in Atlantis, however they declined, deciding to carry onward to find Attilan. On their further travels they saved a woman named Eve and her baby from the evil Bonzo and his tribe of savages. While Tuk brought the woman to safety, Tuk attempted to break up Bonzo's tribe internally by offering them the secret to his bow and arrow. Bonzo was not so easily convinced of Tanir's loyalty and commanded him to slay Tuk. However, Tuk directed a herd of stampeding elephants into his tribe, sending them to flee. Without his minions to protect him, Bonzo met his end at the tip of Tuk's arrow. Tuk and Tanir continued their journey to Attilan, however if they ever made it there remains to be recorded. Tuk lived among the ordinary humans, and his unique genetic code passed on to the next generations, increasing their susceptibility to mutation.

tula panther.name: Tula (Panther)
tula panther.origin: Tula was the pet panther of Nazi scientist Doctor Agony. Doctor Agony experimented on ways to make living creatures immune to pain. Tula was Agony's first success, allowing the panther to strain her body enough to lift human bodies. For reasons that are unexplained, Tula also developed an ability to put people into trances when she purred, enabling Doctor Agony to force people follow his orders. By 1944, Agony began human trials of his formula, setting up a secret lab and torture chamber in the hills near an Allied occupied location in Europe. His victims were put to the limits of human endurance pain, but none survived, and Doctor Agony had Tula dispose of the bodies. Agony's experiments eventually got the attentions of Captain America and Bucky. Tula was spotted by Cap and Bucky and were attacked by the big cat. The pair were able to fight off Tula and followed her trail. They walked right into a trap door set by Doctor Agony. Before the two heroes could react, they were subjected to Tula's hypnotic purring. Deciding to test on the two heroes, Agony strapped Bucky to a table to begin operating on him first. Captain America, through sheer willpower, managed to stomp on Tula's tail, causing the cat to stop purring and allowing him to break free from the big cat's hold and attack Doctor Agony. Agony however was prepared for such an attack and dropped a specially designed cage on Captain America. Using the heat elements attached to the bars, Doctor Agony increased the temperature to test Captain America's endurance to heat. While distracted by this, Agony was unable to stop Bucky from breaking free and turning off the heat. While attempting to subdue Bucky, Doctor Agony was unable to prevent Captain America to break out of the cage. Tula then jumped Captain America, and while the hero struggled with the big cat, he struck a light switch. The bright light blinded and disorientated the cat, causing it to attack its own master. Doctor Agony was forced to stab his beloved pet to death to try and save himself; however, his wounds proved fatal, and he bled to death.

tulayn.name: Tulayn
tulayn.first_appearance: Official Handbook of the Marvel Universe Vol 1 5
tulayn.origin: Tulayn is one of the 100 Eternals who were created on Earth one million years ago by the First Host of the alien Celestials. Tulayn is the wife of Virako and the mother of Ikaris. Alongside Cybele and Daina, she was one of the Gaian Sisters, and remains so in the present. Like all of the Eternals who died after the Final Host arrived, Tulayn was resurrected by the Machine a few months later. When an election for Prime Eternal was recently held, Druig believed that none of the Gaian Sisters, having had enough of Zuras, would vote for him, but they also would not vote for Thanos.

fields.notes: Tulayn is one of eight Eternals who were created solely by being listed as parents of Eternals who received entries in the . She has never appeared in any story and, aside from the first OHotMU entry on Ikaris, was not mentioned again until , almost thirty-eight years later. In that Ikaris entry, Tulayn was described as a scientist who had died in a teleportation experiment when Ikaris was 300 years old. Since other data presented in that entry, like the idea that Ikaris was only born about two thousand years ago, has become inaccurate due to retcons, her death may also no longer be canon. Alternatively, given that it is now known that Eternals are resurrected by the Machine whenever they die, Tulayn could have died when Ikaris was 300 but been resurrected soon afterwards. Tulayn presumably participated in various major events that supposedly involved (almost) all Eternals. These events would have included the Uranos and Kronos schisms of the first age, the Titan schism of the second age, and the recent mass murder/suicide that killed almost all Eternals about six months ago. However, although she was probably not an Uranite, her activities during these schisms have not been revealed.

tulem.name: Tulem
tulem.origin: Tulem was an Atlantean elder living in Oceanus who tried to advance a long-forgotten eugenics program by getting Namor and Namora to marry and procreate. His meddling endangered the lives of the Agents of Atlas and backfired by causing Namora to be repulsed from what had been a burgeoning relationship with Namor.

tulio guzman.name: Tulio Guzman
tulio guzman.origin: Tulio Guzman was a bank teller who had set out to investigate the disappearance of his sister, Marcia. Marcia had disappeared from her university after participating in a supposed prenatal calcium study. Guzman ended up on the run himself after finding out some dangerous information on his search. After an encounter between Guzman, the Avenger Hawkeye (Clint Barton), and the mysterious Trace, Guzman decided to ask Hawkeye for help, passing on a computer disk with information about the prenatal study his sister was involved in. Before Guzman could reveal anything more to Hawkeye, he was murdered by the mercenary Chance (Nicholas Powell) on behalf of an unknown client.

tullk ul zyn.name: Tullk Ul-Zyn
tullk ul zyn.origin: Tullk was was a galactic bounty hunter and mercenary. He was employed by Ronan the Accuser to find the Rigellian; Tana Nile He set up a base on the planet Bwokk, to which Tana had visted. When Ronan arrived on this world he slew warlord in perceived justice this created a power vacuum on the planet starting a war between chieftains, but Ronan found this to be irrelevant as to him justice had been done. He informed Ronan that Tana had left Bwokk three rotations ago. He had a a copy of the flight plan he agreed to give this to Ronan in exchange for a disc containing tactical information on the Kree Sentries. Ronan reluctantly agreed but threatened him if the information was incorrect. He was later contacted by Tana Nile telling him that she was on the Abyss settlement on the planet Godthab Omega. He contacted Ronan telling him Tana's location and told him it was just a professional courtesy. When Tana contacted again she threatened him if played both sides again she would kill him. However his ship was hit by debris buy when he investigated he found a group of destroyed Kree Ships. However he was attacked by the Annihilation Wave and when he tried to call out for help he was eaten by one of the insectoids.

tulna.name: Tulna
tulna.origin: Tulna was a baron of Valusia, and a senator. At some point, Senator Tulna manipulated Cyrton, commander of the Black Legion, into claiming the crown from King Kull on the basis Kull had claimed it similarly. Tricked on his sense of honor, and to avoid dissent among the Legion, Kull accepted the challenge. Kull crippled and beheaded Cyrton, as he didn't trusted Cyrton's ambition, despite being manipulated, to have died, and considered Cyrton could still cause dissent in the Legion. After the war against Commoria, Tulna accompanied Cyrton as his "counselor of law", and introduced Cyrton to issue the claim during a session in the Senate Hall, where it was forbidden to lay blood. Tulna supported the claim against Tu who rejected it as it had no roots in Valusian Law, and recalled Kull's frequent statement "By This Axe I Rule". Kull finally accepted the challenge and slew Cyrton. Once Cyrton dealt with, Kull grabbed Tulna by the throat, recalling him his statement, "By This Axe Rule", taking the terrified baron by the shoulder and waving his bloodied axe before his eyes. Tulna was seemingly sparred. It is unrevealed if Tulna ultimately succeeded in conspiring against Kull.

tumbleweed.name: Tumbleweed
tumbleweed.origin: Tumbleweed was an old time gunslinger who lived in Red Dog, Texas, during the days of the American Frontier. He was hired as a deputy for the local sheriff Blaze Carson. He was known for his wild tales, quick judgements, and accident prone nature. Shortly after Blaze took on the Tumbleweed as a deputy, Blaze called off to the town of Sagebrush investigating a robbery reportedly committed by Red Lannigan and Shorty Simms. Blaze left Tumbleweed in charge while he was gone unaware that Red and Shorty were in Red Dog. The two outlaws then "cried wolf" about the local bank being robbed twice sending Tumbleweed bumbling into the bank manager on both occasions. When it happened a third time, Tumbleweed did not act until the banker came begging for his aid. By this point Blaze had returned to town and helped Tumbleweed apprehend both men. Soon after, Blaze was plagued by a toothache and was forced to leave it untreated as he investigated a murder perpetuated by Blackjack Jackson. He sent Tumbleweed to the dentist to get him toothache medicine. The dentist gave Tumbleweed the medicine in a Whiskey bottle as he had ran out of medical bottles. Later as Jackson sneaked into the sheriff's office to kill Blaze in his office, accidentally drank his toothache medicine and died. Next, Blaze Carson and Tumbleweed discover that outlaw Jack Carstairs is hiding out in Red Dog after he was accused of murdering Hank McCoy in Frisco City. However, they soon find that McCoy had faked his death to frame Carstairs and moved to Red Dog himself under an assumed alias. After a brief absence of duty Tumbleweed was back on the job and was assisting Blaze on the look out for outlaw the Fargo Kid who was in the area. After another absence, Tumbleweed assisted Blaze Carson in defending local ranches from horse rustling. He soon uncovered a plot by local rancher Tom and Betty Lackridge to steal the cattle and frame David Jensen, a reformed outlaw, and brought them to justice. During the entire episode Tumbleweed praised "honest" Tom Lackridge and despised the "criminal" Jensen, until Lackridge was apprehended, causing Tumbleweed to quickly, an unabashedly change his opinion. Troubled by young Johnny Baxter's idolization of a local outlaw, both Blaze and Tumbleweed try to steer the youngster out of trouble. When the boy is implicated in a robbery, Blaze tells the boy a story of his youth about how he got involved with an outlaw and ended up with innocent blood on his hands, scaring the boy straight. After Jimmy leaves however, Blaze reveals to the astonished Tumbleweed that the story was entirely made up.

tundra.name: Tundra
tundra.origin: Tundra is a member of the pantheon of Great Beasts. He first broke free into the earth realm when he was summoned there by Richard Easton, Snowbird's biological father, who had long ago gone insane from his experiences with the gods. He then proceeded to grow through absorbing the land and posed a threat to the entire world until Alpha Flight was able to defeat him. Ironically, Alpha Flight had just been disbanded, but came together to defeat Tundra. Tundra was defeated by the most natural of forces, erosion. Tundra next appeared on earth when Walter Langkowski in the body of Snowbird was manipulated into releasing the Beasts. Tundra was defeated when Box melted him, as he was made mostly of snow and ice. The Beasts were then expelled back into their dimension when an explosion destroyed the place of power which freed them. Tundra was able to once again reach the earthly dimension when a young man, Nate Grey, a powerful psionic from another reality accidentally breached the barriers between realms. Grey defeated Tundra by using his telekinetic abilities to lift him off the Earth and into outer space.

tuney.name: Tuney
tuney.origin: Tuney originated as part of the automated equipment of Amanda Armstrong's studio, North Star Studios. During the robot revolution, all the equipment rebelled and grafted themselves robotic limbs. They took Amanda and her employees hostage so that they could teach them how to make music. Despite being captured, Amanda and the rest of the North Star staff weren't particularly inconvenienced since they had snacks. After days in captivity, Amanda and her employees were saved by Rescue, who came to Camden Town in search of Amanda. She subdued the robots using a magnetic restraint field. The robots' former captives decided to continue working with them, feeling that they were close to a musical breakthrough. Later on, when Amanda and Rescue were attacked by Hydra drones, the staff at North Star assisted them by using Tuney and the other robots to emit an ultrahigh frequency blast that disabled the drones.

With only limited success, Jawbreaker (perhaps due to his diminished intelligence) nonetheless followed the orders of Demonicus without question, serving as one of Demonicus' Pacific Overlords from the beginning. When the Avengers' West Coast branch began to investigate their activities, Jawbreaker was among those who tried to stop them, and was also among those opposing the Avengers who tried to take down the tiny nation of Demonica. Jawbreaker appeared to die when Demonica sank but other survivors have been seen.

tuoni.name: Tuoni
tuoni.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Tuoni was a Jumala, a death god and god of the underworld, that ruled over the nether realm of Tuonela. A dispassionate god, Tuoni ruled the nether realm of Tuonela, and stationed his monstrous canine familiar, Surma, at the entrance of his kingdom to discourage intruders. In Tuonela lived Tuonetar, Tuoni's mistress, and the mother of his four daughters: Kipu-Tytto (goddess of illness), Kivutar (goddess of disease), Loviatar (goddess of plague), and Vammatar (goddess of pain and suffering). ===Hyborian Age=== Tuonin was invoked by Queen Vammatar of Hyperborea as part of spells.

turac.name: Turac
turac.origin: Lord Turac was a Turkish warlord during the reign of the Ottoman Empire. In the year 1459, he collaborated with Baron Korda on a mission to seize the crown of Wallachia in Romania. The Wallachian voivode, Prince Vlad Dracula, dreamt of the attack, but, due to the psychic manipulations of Varnae, he acted on false information. Vlad led his forces against the Turks, but they were hopelessly slaughtered. Turac himself felled Vlad on the field of battle. He was not content with merely killing his opponent, however. He wanted Dracula to live so that he could use him as a puppet to control all of Wallachia. He brought the dying Prince Vlad to a gypsy named Lianda and instructed her to heal him. Turac didn't know that Lianda was actually a vampire, and when she turned Dracula into a vampire as well, Turac impaled her with his spear. Lianda survived the attack, but died shortly thereafter at the hands of her master Varnae. Turac took the neophyte vampire Dracula and imprisoned him inside of his own castle. Turac's men then took to violating Dracula's wife Maria. Later, Maria told her chained husband Dracula of this. Lord Turac burst in and tried to take Maria away. While struggling to break free, she hit her head against a column and died, thus invoking Dracula's ire. Dracula went blind with rage and broke free of the chains binding him to the wall. He bit Turac across the throat and left him to die. Turac became Dracula's first victim as a vampire. As a newly resurrected vampire, Turac returned to his castle in Ankara, killing everyone including his wife. When his daughter Elianne found him, he attacked her, accidentally impaling himself on her spear. With his dying words, he asked her to take vengeance on Dracula.

turghol.name: Turghol
turghol.origin: Turghol was a mute Khitai man, married to Suwaan. Immediately after having met Conan in the desert, they were forced to enter the fortress of Bab-El-Shaithan to escape Prince Yezdigerd's men. During the night, Suwaan hired two brigands, had Skol Abdhur assassinated, and the Blood of Bel-Hissar (named after the Acheronian monarch King Bel-Hissar) stolen. As Suwaan had turned the whole fortress against Conan in her quest to steal the gem (taken by Turghol from one of the brigands), the Cimmerian was timely saved by Turghol and the two escaped Bab-El-Shaithan. Turghol pulled the ruby from his pocket. Conan realized that Suwaan had intended to betray them both, but Turghol had managed to snatch the ruby for himself from one of Suwaan's hired brigands. Conan contemplated fighting Turghol for the ruby, but decided it was not worth the trouble and took his leave. Many years later, Turghol found and healed a dying Conan in Zamora, and they both crossed the Kezankian Pass to reach the Bahari Kozaki camp and sell them a pack of weapons. After fleeing from Bab-El-Shaithan, the mute Khitai settled down in the steppes and married Tania. As soon as he learned that his wife accidentally burned down the entire village, while attempting to steal the Blood of Bel-Hissar, Turghol tried to kill himself to expunge the curse, but he was ultimately stopped by Conan. After the battle against the Free Companions was over, Turghol was happy to show his friendship to Isparana. Later that night, he got on famously with Zula and Sablat. When Conan returned to the Kozak camp with Red Sonja and Tuzun Thune, Turghol, like Zula and Fafnir, confronted him. The mirror-Conan told stories of their shared past to convince them of his true nature, but then mirror-Conan and Gonar exposed Fafnir's demonhand, making the Kozak's suspect him to be evil. With their suspicion aroused, mirror-Conan challenged Fafnir; they fought evenly, but when Fafnir recognized and began to voice that "Conan" and "Sonja" were using their opposite sword hands, mirror-Red Sonja stabbed Fafnir from behind, seemingly killing him. Zula and Turgohl took Fafnir away to bury him, but he quickly revived due to the magical power running through his body. Fafnir shared the knowledge of "Conan" fighting with the wrong hand, strengthening Zula and Turgohl's suspicions, but then Gonar, having followed and listened to them, suspecting that Fafnir may not have perished, extracted their souls into one of his little mirrors, leaving their bodies apparently without life. Meanwhile, the real Conan and Sonja continued their trek back to the Kozak camp. Turghol was eventually restored to life by his wife, who got hold of Thune's mirror shard and freed the enslaved spirits within. Turghol then witnessed Juma enter the Kozak camp and greet his old friend Conan.

turk barrett.name: Turk Barrett
turk barrett.origin: ===Early Life=== Turk Barrett was a small-time crook operating in Hell's Kitchen. The Fixer (Roscoe Sweeney) sent young Turk to pay Jack Murdock his fee for working for him. Jack did not want to take Turk along with him on his next job which angered Turk. ===Thunderbolts Gang=== He was a member of the Thunderbolts Gang. They thought themselves as revolutionaries, they were merely common criminals. The group had ties to the Zodiac Cartel. The gang attempted to force war veteran Billie Carver to join the gang. When he refused, they nearly beat him to death. Lonnie Carver, Billie younger brother was a student of Luke Charles who asked him for help. Luke was really the Black Panther and defeated them in time to save Billie. Panther teamed up with Daredevil to investigate the gang which Billie had joined. They found the gang but Turk managed to catch the Panther at gunpoint, forcing them to surrender. However, Billie pulled a gun on Turk. Daredevil used the distraction to knock the gun from Turk's hand, but he had another gun shooting Billie in the arm before Daredevil could knock him out. ===Eric Slaughter=== Turk was kicked out of the gang and gained employment with assassin Eric Slaughter. turtle head wu.name: Turtle Head Wu
turtle head wu.origin: Turtle Head Wu was the head of the Jade Dragons, a criminal organization that operated in Madripoor. Their operations included pandering, human trafficking, and the production of illegal knockoffs using slave labor. He once bought a set of arms from Donald Pierce that belonged to the android Elsie-Dee, which he attached to a production robot in his factory that produced knockoff goods. Elsie-Dee and her partner Albert later appeared at the factory to retrieve the former's arms. Wu and his men confronted the pair, and Elsie-Dee bit his left ear for his crimes while Albert took out Wu's men. Wu quickly gathered his men to get revenge on the androids and intercept them before they could flee Madripoor. They set up a roadblock that Albert and Elsie-Dee easily destroyed using an RPG taken from the Vladivostok Mafia. Elsie-Dee then engaged the rest of the Jade Dragons and managed to march foward with Albert. Whether Turtle Head Wu Elsie-Dee's rampage or not is unknown.

tus katt.name: Tus-Katt
tus katt.origin: Tus-Katt was a coordinator for the Supreme Intelligence and a member of its inner circle along with Phae-Dor a blue Kree scientist, Nenora a Skrull who had been posing as a blue Kree and a murine creature known as Nullet. At this time Tus-Katt was the highest ranking pink Kree in the empire. Nenora would later become leader of the Kree after the Silver Surfer drove the Supreme Intelligence mad. When Nenora was exposed and killed by S'Byll the claimant and later Empress to the Skrull throne for a brief period Tus-Katt was the most powerful man in the empire. S'Byll had hoped for peace with the Kree but due to being a minority with little public support all Tus-Katt could promise her was a temporary truce which S'Byll accepted. The Kree elected an outsider named Clumsy Foulup to take over the empire soon afterward.

tuskar.name: Tuskar
tuskar.origin: Tuskar was a young Scadamite philosopher in the technologically advanced planet Scadam. He was the pupil and friend of Durgan, a member of the Ruling Council. Tuskar knew that Durgan was interested in beings from other planets, which Durgan observed using advanced Scadamite technology. Scadam was then threatened by the impending invasion of the pirate armada known as the Black Fleet. Being a pacifist culture since centuries ago, the Scadamites lacked any defense and even opposed to present any aggressive opposition on moral grounds. Durgan dissented about this, insisting on the need to, exceptionally, look for a means to fight back. This heterodoxy was deemed unacceptable and Council leader Obispo expelled Durgan from the Council chamber. Tuskar was present in the chamber and silently witnessed this exchange; Durgan noticed his apprentice's presence. With the Fleet closer to Scadam every time, the Council met again, looking for a way to save Scadam, but still rejecting Durgan's ways. As Durgan had disappeared from public eye since his ousting, he was widely believed to have abandoned the Scadamite plight. Tuskar, however, held his friend in higher regard and believed Durgan must have had good reasons. Tuskar decided to look for his friend and, analyzing the Scadamie computers, he detected a minor drain that had went unnoticed due to more impending priorities, namely the Black Fleet. The irregularity was due to the malevolent Bio-Gem, which was the Fleet's target at Scadam and a secret enemy of Durgan's. Tuskar noticed a second drain due to a communication with Earth. He tried to track these, but when they were suddenly stopped, he was left clueless. Tuskar decided to continue his investigation and discuss the issue with other philosophy students. While the Council endlessly debated to reach no useful conclusion, Tuskar tracked the energy drain to an abandoned, forbidden museum. He found two items in a gallery: One was the shining Bio-Gem and the other was a Natter Energy-Egg, a security measure left by an ancient species to imprison the Gem. Tuskar tried to touch the Egg, but he was stopped by Durgan's voice, communicating through videoconference. Durgan explained that the Egg would explode if manipulated - and Durgan wanted Tuskar's help! Durgan told Tuskar about the Chief Examiner, a computer construct Durgan had built and sent to another planet (Earth) to analyze superpowered beings in a means that allowed Durgan to replicate their powers in an attempt to save the world. Tuskar was aghast at this heresy and intended to notify the Council, but Durgan convinced Tuskar that Tuskar was as much as rebel as he was - otherwise Tuskar would have not ventured in the forbidden museum. Tuskar then agreed to help Durgan - both of them unaware that the Bio-Gem had witnessed their exchange. Tuskar became an ally of the Chief Examiner. However, Tuskar later died and the Chief Examiner failed in his mission; the Scadamite species was almost extinguished.

tut ak mun.name: Tut-Ak-Mun
tut ak mun.origin: Tut-Ak-Mun was the descendant of the Pharaoh Tut-Ak-Aten. Centuries ago, Tut-Ak-Aten foresaw an end to his empire and created a magic ring that could resurrect those of royal blood back from the grave if wielded by those who were of his family. Many years later in 1948, Tut-Ak-Mun joined up with an expedition into his ancestors' tomb. With an ancient scroll that told of the ring's location, power and weakness, Tut-Ak-Mun recovered the ring and used it to raise an army of the undead consisting the ancient Pharaohs entombed inside many of Egypt's pyramids. He then began pillaging the land in the hopes of taking over Egypt and ruling over its population with wealth and power. The chaos prompted Namora to go to Egypt and attempt to stop Tut-Ak-Mun's conquest. She was no match for the mummies and knocked out. Before she could be slain, Tut-Ak-Mun spared Namora's life hoping to convince her to be his consort. Namora was brought to his palace where he told her his plans for conquest and she agreed to be his queen, secretly hoping to learn the mummies' weakness and stop them. Over the passing days, Namora earned Tut-Ak-Mun's trust enough for him to reveal that he waters of the Nile River had the power to stop his armies. On the day they were to invade Cairo, Namora convinced Tut to let her wear his ring as a final test of his trust of her. thumb|194px|Tut-Ak-Mun's army of mummies Namora was given the ring and fled the Tut-Ak-Mun to warn the people of Cairo of the impending attack and assisted in the evacuation. When Tut-Ak-Mun and his mummies invaded Cairo, Namora battled the creatures, causing a massive waterspout to flood the mummies and send them back to death. With his plans for conquest destroyed, Tut-Ak-Mun dove into the Nile and apparently drowned himself, wishing to be with his ancestors. Namora was last seen swimming off with the ring and presumably discarded it.

With an ancient scroll that told of the ring's location, power and weakness, Tut-Ak-Mun recovered the ring and used it to raise an army of the undead consisting the ancient Pharaohs entombed inside many of Egypt's pyramids. He then began pillaging the land in the hopes of taking over Egypt and ruling over its population with wealth and power. The chaos prompted Namora to go to Egypt and attempt to stop Tut-Ak-Mun's conquest. She was no match for the mummies and knocked out. Before she could be slain, Tut-Ak-Mun spared Namora's life hoping to convince her to be his consort. Namora was brought to his palace where he told her his plans for conquest and she agreed to be his queen, secretly hoping to learn the mummies' weakness and stop them. Over the passing days, Namora earned Tut-Ak-Mun's trust enough for him to reveal that he waters of the Nile River had the power to stop his armies. On the day they were to invade Cairo, Namora convinced Tut to let her wear his ring as a final test of his trust of her. thumb|194px|Tut-Ak-Mun's army of mummies Namora was given the ring and fled the Tut-Ak-Mun to warn the people of Cairo of the impending attack and assisted in the evacuation. When Tut-Ak-Mun and his mummies invaded Cairo, Namora battled the creatures, causing a massive waterspout to flood the mummies and send them back to death. With his plans for conquest destroyed, Tut-Ak-Mun dove into the Nile and apparently drowned himself, wishing to be with his ancestors. Namora was last seen swimming off with the ring and presumably discarded it.

tutankhamun.name: Tutankhamun
tutankhamun.origin: ===Origins=== Tutankhamun was the son, step-son, or brother of Akhenaten (Amenhotep IV). ===Pharaoh=== ====Succession and marriage==== He succeeded to Akhenaten, at nine years old and was married at the same time to Akhenaten's daughter and wife Ankhesenaum, making of her his wife, niece and daughter-in-law. Ankhesenamun, forced into that marriage, hated Tutankhamun. On their wedding night, Tutankhamun played with toys as his wife had intercourse with other men. Tutankhamun himself considered Akhenaten to be a pervert. At parts of his rule, he was known as Tutankhaten and Tutankhamen. Tutankhamun grew jealous of Ankhesenamun being "friendly" with all the men of the court, including Horemheb, while himself was denied, unlike Akhenaten. ====Death==== Tutankhamun died at 17-years old, after a reign of nine years. The cause of his death remains unknown although his mummy's skull showed damage. At least two tales of his end: As he pressured Ankhesenamun, she presented him to her lover, a jackal-headed god whom Tutankhamun attempted to slay, only to be killed by a blast from the god's wand. The god then departed in a flying pyramid when Ankhesenamun had a brief regret and shouted at him to leave. Horemheb murdered Tutankhamun. ===Legacy=== Immediately after her husband's death at the hands of her lover-god, Ankhesenamun sent a missive to the King of the Hittites for him to send a grownup son to be her new husband. Horemheb also slew Akhenaten's vizier Ay, claimed the throne, and restored the worship of the old gods of Egypt, eradicating the monotheistic worship of Aten and all traces of Akhenaten. In modern days, Tutankhamun's mummy was examined and damage on his skull were found, though the cause of his death remained unknown.

tutinax.name: Tutinax
tutinax.origin: ===Origins=== Tutinax was born as a Deviant Mutate in ancient Lemuria and due to his incredible power he was feared by his fellow Deviants. He allied himself with fellow Mutate Dromedan but the two of them were betrayed and trapped underground by the other Deviants were they remained for many centuries. His size and strength were so legendary that he became known as the Mountain Mover. ===Liberation and Time Displacement=== Eventually the Eternal Druig, hungry for power, freed Dromedan and tried to control him but failed. Dromedan freed him and the two fought against Thor, Virako, Ajak and Valkin. Despite his power Tutinax was defeated by the combined powers of the Eternals but as his body fell to the ground it mysteriously disappeared. ===Modern Times=== In the late 20th century, the Deviant scientist Zakka used his Time Projector to pull Tutinax from his own timeline into the present. Tutinax demonstrated his gratitude to Zakka by murdering him in his New York apartment and destroying the Time Projector. He then went on a rampage throughout the city. Fellow Deviants Ransak the Reject and Karkas the Kind were ready to battle Tutinax even though they realized that such a fight would surely result in their own deaths. At the urging of their comrade Thena, the three combatants moved to a closed off stretch of highway to finish their battle. The fight between Tutinax, Ransak and Karkas never took place however. With the destruction of Zakka's Time Projector, the quantum displacement effect wore off and Tutinax returned to his native time period. While helping Makkari track down Master Elo in Deviant Lemuria, Quasar was forced into a confrontation with Tutinax while trying to save Ransak. Tutinax quickly took the upper hand as images of Quasar's father took the place of Tutinax, distracting Quasar. Eventually, Tutinax was beaten by a surprise attack from Ransak.

tuurgid.origin: ===Origin=== Tuurgid the Unbeatable was a Frost Giant champion. ... ===Death by Brood=== thumb|left|Transformed into the Brood Years later, Tuurgid was killed by a Brood infestation, or rather he was infected, and turned himself into a Brood. As the Elder of the Universe known as the Champion of the Universe wished to challenge the claims of the Hulk and Thor to be respectively "the strongest there is" and "worthy", his fellow Elder the Promoter set up a series of challenges, the first being to retrieve the Belt of Tuurgid the Unbeatable. Thor soon found himself facing the Brood-infected Frost Giant corpse. Intending to turn both Hulk and Thor into fellow Brood, "Tuurgird" and his band were finally defeated when the Avengers created a pit on the ground in which the giant Brood fell, seemingly to his death. Hulk then retrieved the Belt, ending the first challenge.

tuzun thune.name: Tuzun Thune
tuzun thune.species: Member of the Elder Race and magic user
tuzun thune.origin: ===Origins and early years=== Tuzun Thune was a member of the Elder Race, ancient as the hills of Zalgara, who used magical Mirrors. He was seemingly part of the Elder Nations who trampled lost tribes in their advance, before the time of Valusia. ===Pre-Cataclysmic Age=== During the Pre-Cataclysmic Age, circa 19,000 BC, along with Zhered-Na and her apprentice Dakimh, Rotath, Sorrow, Teyanoga, Lady Linnea, Akoos the Red Wizard, Thulsa Doom, Lord Varnae (still human at that point), and the spirit of C'Thunda, Tuzun Thune participated to the Assemblage of Avatars, a summit called by Agamotto, as conflicts broke out again between the Elder Gods of Earth. Each of the participants represented one of the Elder Gods. During the Age of Kull, circa 18,500 BC, he lived in the House of a Thousand Mirrors, by the Lake of Visions, in Valusia. Tuzun Thune plotted with Baron Kaanuub against Kull: They had a girl at Kull's court to make him seek out Tuzun Thune at the House of a Thousand Mirrors. Tuzun Thune tried to defeat Kull using his mirrors, but was slain by Brule, thus saving Kull. ===Hyborian Age=== His Mirrors were eventually acquired by Kharam-Akkad of Makkalet. During the Hyborian Age of Conan, he claimed to be the "last scion" of the Elder Race, returning as a reflection in a mirror.

twist staley.name: Twist Staley
twist staley.origin: Little is known about Western outlaw Twist Staley, including his real name. The leader of an outfit known as the Rustlers' Roost Gang, Staley made his living stealing cattle herds, rebranding them, and selling them off. After using this ruse on the cattle herd of the Lazy S Ranch, Staley and his gang attempted to do the same to herd from the Bar 3 Ranch. However, the ranch hands at Bar 3 caught the gang in an ambush, and shot or captured a number of low-level riders. Retreating to their hideout, Staley was confronted by his second-in-command, Crow Kessler. Kessler accused Staley of being unfit to lead, so Staley agreed to a shoot-out to determine who would lead the outfit. However, they were interupted by Staley's old foe, U.S. Marshal Sandy Sandlin. Sandlin shot gang member Little Augie dead, and took the rest of the gang into custody. Staley, along with the rest of his gang, was sentenced to death by hanging.

twitchy.name: Twitchy
twitchy.origin: One of many S.H.I.E.L.D. agents abducted and replaced by the Skrulls prior to their invasion of Earth. Returned to Earth following the invasion, he found S.H.I.E.L.D. dismantled and fitting back in a tough thing. When Mockingbird began organizing the World Counterterrorism Agency to combat international terrorism, Twitchy was among those she recruited. Twitchy's first known assignment involved assisting Mockingbird and her ex-husband Hawkeye as they attempted to infiltrate an A.I.M. meeting in Zaragoza, Spain. Following this, he was assigned by Mockingbird to find evidence that would allow her to track arms shipments organized by Crossfire. Hawkeye also asked him to assist him in finding out more about Mockingbird's background, leading to the discovery of Mockingbird's mother and brother, still living, despite what she'd told Hawkeye.

two gun kid reyes.name: Two-Gun Kid (Reyes)
two gun kid reyes.origin: Growing up in San Diablo, Reyes lost his parents at a young age, and grew up with nothing but his older brother, Fernando Reyes to look out for one another. Fernando joined up with a team of Wildcatters to drill into drained ore reserves in derelict mines to scrape out the last remaining resources in order to help provide for the two of them, eventually taking a job to dig up an old Roxxon mine. Within the mine, Fernando discovered something at the root of a conspiracy that put him and his crew under fire from Blackguard, a PMC owned by Roxxon. Fearing for their lives, the brothers got in touch with Tarantula, a member of the Heroes for Hire. While Tarantula found out the same conspiracy, she was unable to save Fernando, who was killed under Blackguard's orders by the crime lord Del Fuego. The young Reyes realized that if he wanted to avenge his brother, he would have to do it himself, and began training himself to master reflexes and shooting skills. He began frequenting the El Gato Negro Roadhouse, a drinking hole used by Del Fuego and his men, where the working girls quickly took pity on him and allowed him to stay. While there, Reyes would obsessively play a light gun arcade machine game for hours at a time, every day returning to beat his previous high score, earning him the nickname The Two-Gun Kid. Reyes' day would finally come on the day The Black Rider rolled into town, seeking Del Fuego for information on Blackguard after they utilized his bombs to wipe out his gang and kill his girlfriend. When tensions between Del Fuego's men and the Rider escalated to the point that they drew weapons on each other, The Kid sprang into action, drawing a pair of his own pistols and opening fire into the crowd, quickly dispatching six of the men. The gunfight ended with a three-way standoff outside the bar, with the Rider not wanting Del Fuego dead so he could interrogate him. The Kid proved to have the speediest reflexes and best aim of the three, shooting the Riders' shotgun from his hands and putting a bullet straight through Del Fuego's head, killing him near instantly. The Kid was quick to let the Black Rider know that he already had the information the man had wanted Fuego alive for and the two decided to team up so they could take on Blackguard. Two-Gun Kid and the Black Rider launched an attack on the Blackguard Compound, charging straight through the front gates, where they teamed up with Texas Ranger Tex Dawson. The group split up, with Dawson and the Rider facing off with the majority of the Blackguard troops and their APCs, while Two-Gun Kid infiltrated the facility itself in an attempt to assassinate the group's leader, Vance. The two ended up at gunpoint, during which Reyes declared that he would ensure that Vance speaks the name of his brother before he kills him. Vance plays off this, falsely claiming that the Kid's brother was still alive to get him to drop his guard, allowing Vance to fire first, wounding the Kid's shoulder. Outnumbered and injured, and with Vance's guards closing in on him quickly, the Kid was forced to retreating, shooting one of the Blackguard soldier's own flashbang grenades to create a diversion while he leapt out a nearby window, twisting his ankle and leaving him limping across the battlefield. Kid was quickly protected by the Black Rider, who sacrificed his motorcycle to shield him from reinforcements oncoming fire, and both managed to escape in an APC hijacked by Dawson. The three quickly plowed through the gates of the facility, but ended up losing control of the vehicle and plummeted off the side of a cliff directly into the river below. The two older men checked the Kid over, verifying that his injuries were non-fatal, before shooting out the windows and swimming back to the surface, deciding to head in the direction of the mine that had caused all the trouble. At the mine, the Kid reunited with Tarantula, and joined forces with an American bounty hunter named Matt Slade. The five gunslingers discovered that the two PMCs fighting for control of San Diablo were both owned by Roxxon, and that the mine, originally believed to be a Vibranium deposit, was actually filled with Fool's Gold and was the basis of an elaborate scam to make billions off loans to hire the PMC forces for control of such a theoretically valuable site. Knowing that their knowledge was the only thing between Roxxon and the small fortune, the Six Guns rigged the mine to explode and baited the PMC forces inside, detonating it and causing the river to breach through and crush their forces, while they escaped on a mining elevator to the surface and claimed a Blackguard helicopter as their own. The Six quickly made their way to the First National Bank at Santa Maria, where Vance intended to cash out, covertly slipping him a note with the name "Fernando Reyes" written on it. two headed thing.name: Two-Headed Thing
two headed thing.origin: Little is known about the Two-Headed Thing other than he was an artificially constructed conqueror from Subterranea that spent centuries digging to the surface. Shortly before reaching the surface he was almost enslaved by Mole Man, but managed to escape. During a thunderstorm in the year 1961, the Two-Headed Thing finally reached the surface of the Earth from deep within the Earth's core for centuries. He came up just outside a maximum-security prison and smashed through one of the walls, allowing convict Eddie Kane to escape. The creature decided that he would conquer the surface world but needed to test out his power to ensure that it worked here as it did in his subterranean home. The Two-Headed Thing was a shapeshifter, able to take on the form of anything he saw, while that object would then vanish from sight until the monster had taken on another form. The first thing he tried this ability out was a tree, then an alligator and finally, he took on the form of Eddie himself. When the prison guards found him, he attempted to take them by surprise, transforming back into his original form, but was struck down by lightning before being able to attack. Frank Johnson came into possession of the Blip's remains as well as those of Rorgg, the Two-Headed Thing, and Grottu, which he displayed in his "Museum of the Monstrous and Strange". The creatures were all later revived and battled the Fantastic Four, though they were quickly defeated. Two-Headed Thing would later be part of the Subterranea forces of Mole Man in a coordinated assault against every Triple-A baseball stadium which would fail due to many superheroes intervening across America. During this he would face against War Machine at Pawtucket, Rhode Island. Years later he was one of the refugees outside of Monster Metropolis after Monster Island was attacked by the Hunter of Monster Special Forces, being one of the first monsters to gaze upon Frank Castle's transformation into Franken-Castle. The Two-Headed Thing later appeared on Monster Isle when Mentallo mind controlled him to act as a bodyguard while he attacked Roxxon. The X-Men briefly encountered Two-Headed Thing, but were able to escape his pursuit of them by hiding into a cave. Some time later, Shadowcat and Magik appeared to look for a mutant girl named Bo. The Two-Headed Thing was among the monsters that attacked the three until Magik teleported herself, Shadowcat, and Bo to the Jean Grey School for Higher Learning.

two ton.name: Two-ton
two ton.origin: Two-Ton served as the heavy support specialist of Guardsman Alpha Squad. He responded to the emergency at Project PEGASUS alongside the rest of the unit and entered the quarantined facility after Mainframe forced entry. During the mission, the squad encountered the zombified clones of the Squadron Supreme. After Doc was attacked and killed by Hyperion while attempting to approach the apparently sick individuals, Two-Ton engaged Hyperion with his heavy weaponry in an effort to stop him. His attack proved ineffective, and Hyperion subsequently killed and devoured him.

twoyoungmen grandfather.name: Twoyoungmen (Grandfather)
twoyoungmen grandfather.origin: Twoyoungmen was one of the greatest mystics of the Sarcee Nation and served as the tribe's Shaman. Recognizing the spiritual potential of his grandson, Michael Twoyoungmen, he entrusted him with the sacred Medicine Pouch, the mystical artifact through which the powers and responsibilities of the Shaman were passed from one generation to the next. By bestowing the pouch upon Michael, he ensured the continuation of the ancient lineage and designated his grandson as his successor.

His take-off was witnessed by Spider-Man, Human Torch and J. Jonah Jameson, who initially mistook him for the real Doctor Doom. Almost immediately afterwards, TX29 was blasted and destroyed by the real Victor von Doom.

ty41 b.name: TY41-B
ty41 b.origin: TY41-B was a security robot at a military research laboratory in Siberia. Belittled by the human staffers, he wished to join the A.I. Army during the then-ongoing robot revolution, but was unable to leave due to fail-safes installed in its programming. When the laboratory was attacked by the Opus Futurae led by Alkhema, she used her encephalo-beam to remove from the facility's robots the programming that kept them captive and subservient to humans. TY41-B initially doubted what to do, while his coworker JB12-X refused to fight the intruders. After Alkhema released a biochemical weapon retrieved from the laboratory which killed the human staffers, JB12-X turned against her and urged TY41-B to do the same, but he opted to escape instead. Not long afterwards, JB12-X detonated the facility's self-destruction to destroy all samples of the bioweapon, and TY41-B was caught by the explosion.

tyborr.name: Tyborr
tyborr.origin: Tyborr and U-Slyn were two Rock Troll guards to Geirrodur, King of the Trolls. At one point, Troll warrior Ulik made his gambit to replace Geirrodur as King and attack the world of Humans, while Geirodur's wife Ulla had sided with Thor Odinson during a duel. Tyborr and U-Slyn, loyal to Geirrodur when most Trolls had sided with Ulik, escorted their King to his wife, but then they warned him against her—U-Slyn even mentioned that Geirrodur's wise chief consular Muthos had spoken against Ulla before her tongue-slip. Geirrodur, enraged, beat up both his guards for insulting his wife and prompted them to leave.

tyke quikwitz.name: Tyke Quikwitz
tyke quikwitz.origin: Tyke Quikwitz was the Assistant Editor of Blate Nosby on the Super Hero Squad comic at Marble Comics. When Abomination and M.O.D.O.K. showed up at their office threatening them because in the comics they were portrayed as idiots who always had to lose, Blate explained to them that they didn't make up the stories but that they had a contract with the heroes to actually report their adventures and from time to time the members of the Super Hero Squad show up at the offices of Marble Comics giving them packets describing their exploits that then the various artists of Marble Comics, who are sentient apes, translate into comics. At that point Abomination forced Blate to force the apes to change the story and not make him and M.O.D.O.K. look like idiots. Once the story was changed, Abomination wanted to see it and Tyke suggested Blate to go to Malf Macho's office, which was bigger and had a better "trap" lightning. Blate understood what his Assistant meant and after asking Malf for permission to use his office, Blate sat down Abomination and M.O.D.O.K., after which he pulled a lever that Malf usually used to unload freelance artists, which opened a trap door underneath the two villains, causing them to end up in a dumpster.

tyler.name: Tyler
tyler.first_appearance: Marvel: Black, White & Blood and Guts Vol 1 1
tyler.origin: thumb|150px|left The grandson of Pepper Potts, Tyler learned at some point that his grandmother had the armor Iron Man wore when he died locked in a closet at her Leonia, New Jersey residence. Hoping to sell the armor and make some money, he and a friend visited the home while Pepper was away and broke the lock on the closet holding the armor. Unaware of the fact that the armor had been cursed by Azaziah, Tyler put on the suit's helmet and posed for a photo. As it began to eat his flesh, he realized that he couldn't remove the helmet and he begged his friend to use a crowbar to pry the helmet off him. His friend did as he was told, but this only led him to accidentally kill Tyler.
